item.title: Emma Stone Confirms She Will Not Star as Miss Piggy in New Film: 'Why Would I Play a Literal Star?'
item.description: As BroadwayWorld previously reported, Emma Stone will be executive producing Cole Escola's new Miss Piggy film alongside Jennifer Lawrence. item.description: Cynthia Erivo is not expected to attend the 83rd Golden Globes this Sunday.
